backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor placeholder for backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two rebuild tasks related to UI import fixes and toast component replacement.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Mapping of frontend file paths to short descriptions summarizing their roles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles and theme variables defining light and dark UI color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React application root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router, global providers, and app layout including Toaster and theming.
Layout wrapper providing navigation, page container, and footer around routed content.
frontend/src/components/people/DeletePer: Deletion confirmation dialog preventing removal of people referenced in split transactions.
frontend/src/components/people/PersonCar: Card UI displaying a person with edit and delete actions and dialogs.
frontend/src/components/people/PersonFor: Dialog form for adding or editing people with validation and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/transactions/Rec: Component for uploading, previewing, and removing receipt images using FileReader and controlled state.
frontend/src/components/transactions/Spl: UI for adding, editing, and removing split payment entries tied to people and amounts.
frontend/src/components/transactions/Tra: Dialog form for creating or editing transactions with fields, validation, splits, and receipt attachments.
frontend/src/components/transactions/tra: Validates transaction fields, ensuring totals, splits, and vendor selection meet required rules.
frontend/src/components/vendors/DeleteVe: Confirmation dialog that blocks vendor deletion if referenced by transactions.
frontend/src/components/vendors/VendorCa: Displays vendor info with edit and delete actions, including related dialogs.
frontend/src/components/vendors/VendorFo: Dialog for adding or editing vendor details with simple validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks to manage Internet Identity auth state, including loading, login, and clearing identities.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes and color palettes.
frontend/src/lib/balances/computeBalance: Computes per-person owed balances from split transactions and returns them sorted descending.
frontend/src/lib/storage/indexedDb.ts: Implements IndexedDB-based persistence for people, vendors, and transactions with CRUD operations.
frontend/src/lib/storage/LocalDataProvid: Provides a React context exposing local data, loading state, and CRUD methods for people, vendors, and transactions.
frontend/src/lib/storage/schema.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for people, vendors, transactions, and local data, plus schema version.
frontend/src/lib/storage/useLocalData.ts: React hook that loads and manages local data via IndexedDB, exposing CRUD functions with auto-refresh.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/BalancesPage.tsx: Displays outstanding balances computed from split transactions, including totals and per-person amounts.
frontend/src/pages/PeoplePage.tsx: Lists people sorted by name and provides UI for adding and managing person records.
frontend/src/pages/TransactionDetailPage: Displays details for a selected transaction with edit and delete actions, using local data context and dialog components.
frontend/src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx: Lists all transactions sorted by date and provides a dialog to create new transactions.
frontend/src/pages/VendorsPage.tsx: Shows all vendors sorted by name and allows creating new vendors via a dialog.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, plugins, and custom animations.
project_state.json: Contains project metadata, known issues, and feature requests for the Payment Manager frontend.
